recorded.prompt:q-budget-check: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-budget-check: "For each start year it asks whether some year of the project's work costs more than that year's budget. Only when every start year fails is there a problem." 5,000 fits 2029's 5,200.

recorded.outcome:q-sound: Lines 151-153: "Suppose the floor check added only the projects a good plan would fund. It would then fire whenever that plan fell short, even though another plan meets the floor."

recorded.prompt:q-budget-check:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-budget-check:a: "Only when every start year fails is there a problem". 2029 does not fail.
recorded.prompt:q-budget-check:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-budget-check:b: Same passage: failing one start year (the earliest) is not enough.
recorded.prompt:q-budget-check:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-budget-check:d: The check compares each year's spend to "that year's budget" (c_{i,k} > B_{t+k}), not a total over all years.
recorded.prompt:q-sound:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-sound:b: The page names the flaw as firing when a plan exists (lines 150-153), not missing a floor. The page never says last year's plan funded every project, and the sound check sums every project not forced out.
recorded.prompt:q-sound:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-sound:c: Line 139: the floor check adds every project "except those forced out", and the reference uses i not in D. Forced-out projects are left out, not added back.
recorded.prompt:q-sound:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-sound:d: Lines 126-128: checks "read only the input... so they cost far less than a solve". Speed is not the flaw the page names.
recorded.prompt:q-incomplete:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-incomplete:a: "sound, but not complete... passing every check proves nothing."
recorded.prompt:q-incomplete:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-incomplete:b: Lock with crews restored: "no problem found", yet INFEASIBLE because of a real conflict between projects.
recorded.prompt:q-incomplete:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-incomplete:c: "That is a conflict between projects": data that passes the checks can still clash.
